integrity_notes: All-size proof from exact stationary moment equations. Finite-state count-process verifier checks 48 exact rational stationary solutions; no independent external scientific audit or novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple complete bipartite contacts, homogeneous fair resetting at fixed positive rate and one-neighbor copying at unit rate; conclusions concern unweighted stationary spin averages, not modality or limiting distributions.
title: A sharp self-averaging criterion for noisy voting on complete bipartite networks
